name: backward-interleaving-multi-replica
description: Backward insertion spanning two replicas: replica 2 inserts 'b', replica 0 receives it and prepends 'a', while replica 1 concurrently inserts 'x' into a document it has not yet synced. Yjs produces axb here.

expected.rationale: Backward non-interleaving, multi-replica. Yjs 13.5.44 yields axb here (arXiv A.1.9); Table 1 proves Fugue does not.
